question: What worldly dominion results from conquering a four-limbed army?
premises: A four-limbed army can be conquered.
Conquest of such an army is accomplished.
Universal sovereignty becomes attainable through that conquest.
inference: Conquering a four-limbed army leads to becoming a partaker of universal sovereignty.
uncertainties: Whether the four-limbed army and universal sovereignty are meant literally or metaphorically in this ritual context is not explicit.
plain_english: Having conquered a four-limbed army, one becomes a partaker of universal sovereignty.
